北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阳光好，但体感仅 2℃，注意保暖，多喝水哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels like 2℃. Stay warm and hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪大雾弥漫，体感 5℃ 较冷，出行注意安全，记得添衣。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy and feels cold at 5℃. Drive safe and dress warmly!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海雾气重，体感 8℃ 湿度大，注意交通，室内多通风。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is foggy, 8℃ with high humidity. Drive safe and ventilate indoors.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光明媚，26℃ 暖洋洋，早晚温差大，记得备薄外套。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and warm at 26℃. Mind temperature drops in mornings/evenings.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，23℃ 气温宜人，湿度适中，多喝水保持活力。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast and pleasant at 23℃. Stay hydrated and active!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有阵雨，体感 6℃ 湿冷，出门带伞，注意路滑多保暖。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has showers, feels damp and cold at 6℃. Take an umbrella, watch for slippery roads.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京大雾弥漫，体感 2℃ 寒冷，出行务必减速慢行，多穿衣。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy and feels like 2℃. Drive slowly, stay warm!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，10℃ 气温舒适，风力微弱，记得多运动保持好心情。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and comfy at 10℃. Low wind, stay active and positive!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾，体感 3℃ 湿冷，出行注意交通安全，添衣保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy and feels damp cold at 3℃. Drive safe, stay warm!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 3℃ 较冷且干燥，注意保暖，记得多补充水分。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and feels cold at 3℃ with low humidity. Stay warm and hydrated!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 8℃ 湿度高，多喝热水，保持身体暖暖的。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, feels 8℃ with high humidity. Drink hot water to stay warm!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 -19℃ 寒风凛冽，务必全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but feels like -19℃ with strong winds. Bundle up and prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -19℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感 -11℃ 寒冷，出门记得多穿，小心着凉。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and feels cold at -11℃. Dress warmly and avoid catching a cold!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 10℃ 凉爽，风力适中，注意保暖，心情好。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast and feels cool at 10℃. Moderate wind, stay warm and cheerful!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，23℃ 气温适宜，吹着东风，享受美好的一天吧。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and pleasant at 23℃ with an easterly breeze. Enjoy your day!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 1℃ 且风力大，海边风更凉，多加衣物。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels cold at 1℃ with strong winds. Dress very warmly!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，体感 -3℃ 寒冷，但有阳光，出门记得多晒晒太阳。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny but feels cold at -3℃. Dress warmly and enjoy the sunshine!
